text:
Marco: Heads up — sudden flash burst from scheduled jobs in eu-west. GPU nodepool 'eu-gpu-spot-1' is fully saturated, many pods Pending. Autoscaler not provisioning due to ENI attach errors in cloud logs. Appears cron jobs fired concurrently.
ops-bot: Monitoring alert: nodepool eu-gpu-spot-1 utilization 100% (47/47 GPUs). Cloud events: AttachNetworkInterfaceLimitExceeded for multiple nodes.
Priya: On it. Can someone cordon that nodepool so we don't keep scheduling new GPU pods there? @oncall please coordinate.
Alex: Cordon + taint applied to nodes in eu-gpu-spot-1 to stop new scheduling. Commands run: `kubectl cordon gpu-nodepool-eu-1-*` and `kubectl taint nodes -l nodepool=eu-gpu-spot-1 gpu-pool-overload=true:NoSchedule`
Wei: Scaling up eu-gpu-dedicated (reserved pool) and bumping min nodes to 6 as an emergency. K8s autoscaler config updated to be a bit more aggressive.
Jordan: We should fallback high-traffic inference routes to CPU-backed replicas to immediately relieve GPU pressure. Rolling canary to cpu-fallback now.
Priya: Root cause quick check: research CronJob 'research-batch' had concurrency set to 50 (typo). Patching to concurrency 4 and adding backoff.
Alex: Patch applied for the cronjob. Example command used:
```
kubectl patch cronjob research-batch -p '{"spec":{"concurrencyPolicy":"Forbid","successfulJobsHistoryLimit":3,"failedJobsHistoryLimit":1}}'
```
deploy-bot: Canary deploy: inference-service traffic-split -> cpu-fallback 30% (started).
Marco: Cloud team confirms ENI quota exhausted for the account in eu-west-1. Quota request opened with provider but will take time. That's why new nodes couldn't get network interfaces attached.
Wei: Workaround: spun up ephemeral nodes using pre-attached secondary ENIs (manual workflow) to get 2 nodes back online quickly. Not sustainable but buys time.
Priya: Observability: token-per-token cost spike while jobs retried. I'm enabling temporary token caps on the research SA to limit runaway job retries.
Jordan: Metrics: once CPU fallback routing applied GPU queue decreased ~65%, pending GPU pods started draining. Autoscaler settled after ~3 minutes once ENI workaround was up.
Marco: Post-incident actions (quick list): 1) default CronJob concurrency policy to 5 for research namespaces, 2) add ENI usage alert at 70% of quota, 3) tune cluster-autoscaler backoff and pod-burst controls, 4) request permanent ENI quota increase and document ENI workaround. I'll open an incident ticket with checklist.
ops-bot: Incident duration ~13m. Please add final status and close when ready.
Alex: Marking this thread: contained -> GPU saturation resolved, autoscaler stable, cronjob patched. Leaving ticket for follow-ups.
Priya: I'll own the follow-ups (quota request + CRD to enforce cron concurrency). Closing from my side once ticket created. :white_check_mark:
